"""Recompute the bootstrap-derived columns (se_boot, se_boot_cmp, p_flip_boot, z_boot) and the model table of a finished core unit
with the current Prepared (compact cluster ids).  Needed because the first version of Prepared counted empty clusters (clusters of
battles outside a sub-sample) in the resample size, which inflated the cluster-bootstrap SE of the single-turn Arena units by ~8%.
k*, gap, z_fisher and the null are unaffected.  Same seeds as core01.py.  usage: 01b_refresh_boot.py UNIT [UNIT...]"""
import os, sys
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src")); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import analysis as A
from core01 import OUT, get


def refresh(unit):
    fn = f"{OUT}/core/{unit.replace(':', '_')}.parquet"
    r = pd.read_parquet(fn)
    boot, seed = int(r.boot.iloc[0]), int(r.seed.iloc[0])
    P = A.Prepared(get(unit))
    tb = P.bootstrap_theta(boot, np.random.default_rng(seed), by="cluster")
    tbi = P.bootstrap_theta(boot, np.random.default_rng(seed + 1), by="comparison")
    ga = tb[:, r.a.values] - tb[:, r.b.values]
    gi = tbi[:, r.a.values] - tbi[:, r.b.values]
    r["se_boot"], r["se_boot_cmp"] = ga.std(0, ddof=1), gi.std(0, ddof=1)
    r["p_flip_boot"], r["p_flip_boot_cmp"] = (ga <= 0).mean(0), (gi <= 0).mean(0)
    r["z_boot"] = r.gap / r.se_boot
    r["ncl"] = P.ncl
    r.to_parquet(fn)
